statring.label: Stat ring: Ring of Strength <+2> vs Ring of Soulkeeping
statring.explanation: Original: the Ring of Strength <+2> is guessed at 500 (no stat credit), below the Ring of Soulkeeping at 600, so the Borg sells the Ring of Strength. Corrected: 500 + 2 x 200 = 900, so it sells the Ring of Soulkeeping and keeps the Ring of Strength. The game's own values are 1116 (Strength <+2>) and 1050 (Soulkeeping).

speed.label: Speed item: Cloak 'Colannon' <+2> vs Amulet of ESP
speed.explanation: Original: Colannon is guessed at 21500 (artifact cost 20000 + armour bonus 1500, no speed credit), below the Amulet of ESP at 25000, so the Borg sells Colannon. Corrected: 21500 + 2 x 30000 (speed) + 2 x 100 (stealth) = 81700, capped at 30000 for the sale order, so it sells the Amulet of ESP and keeps Colannon. The game's own values are 11550 (Colannon) and 7134 (ESP).
